title: DeepLink Parameters
description: Parameters for the fractal viewer URL hash fragment. The viewer reads these from window.location.hash on load and encodes them on every navigation action. Format: BASE_URL/#f={f}&x={x}&y={y}&ps={ps}&r={r}&i={i}&p={p}

f.description: Fractal identifier (snake_case). Must match an id in /api/fractals.json. The viewer falls back to 'mandelbrot' for unknown values.

x.description: Center X coordinate on the real axis of the complex plane

y.description: Center Y coordinate on the imaginary axis of the complex plane

ps.description: Pixel size: how many complex-plane units correspond to one pixel. Controls zoom level. Typical values: 4e-3 (full view), 1e-6 (deep zoom), 1e-12 (extreme zoom). The viewer uses logarithmic interpolation during animated navigation.

r.description: Rotation angle in radians. Applied to the complex plane before sampling. Range: 0 to 2π (values outside are accepted but normalized). Default: 0.

i.description: Maximum iterations for escape-time computation. Higher values reveal finer detail at the cost of render time. Default: 256.

p.description: Color palette identifier. Default: aurora. Use /api/palettes.json for descriptions.
